security.title: Improper Initialization
security.description: The product does not initialize or incorrectly initializes a resource, which might leave the resource in an unexpected state when it is accessed or used.

evidence.explanation: JobsSearch static constructor (lines 24-39) catches client/configuration initialization failures and leaves _indexClient and _indexZipClient null; the public query methods can subsequently dereference those uninitialized clients.

security.title: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
security.description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the resource is no longer needed.

evidence.explanation: SendSearchRequest (line 65) returns each HttpResponseMessage without disposing it. DataLoader callers in Program.cs retain and inspect the response but do not dispose it, so the response and its underlying resources are not deterministically released.

security.title: Missing Release of File Descriptor or Handle after Effective Lifetime
security.description: The product does not release a file descriptor or handle after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the file descriptor/handle is no longer needed.

evidence.explanation: SendSearchRequest (line 65) returns HttpResponseMessage instances without disposing them. DataLoader callers in Program.cs do not dispose these responses, leaving underlying response/connection resources open until nondeterministic cleanup.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: The client-side map initialization embeds a non-placeholder API credential directly in the source view. This is an exposed hard-coded credential; the value is redacted from this assessment.

security.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
security.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

evidence.explanation: UpdateJobDetails inserts Azure Search document values into HTML using jQuery .html() without HTML encoding. Fields such as business_title and work_location are rendered directly at lines 49-52 and 79-80; CleanText at line 68 only performs text replacements and does not encode markup before rendering job_description. If indexed job content contains attacker-controlled markup, it can execute in viewers’ browsers.
